note: One prompt per week. The gallery picks prompts[isoWeek % length], so edit the list freely — add, remove, reorder — it keeps rotating on its own.

prompts.text: Build a game you can finish in one sitting.
prompts.hint: One screen, one rule, sixty seconds.

prompts.text: Make a game with only one button.
prompts.hint: Tap or Space. Everything else is the design.

prompts.text: Put a paper game on a screen.
prompts.hint: Dots and boxes, sprouts, hangman — anything pen and paper.

prompts.text: Make something two people can play on one keyboard.
Build a game that ends with a score and a reason to try again.
prompts.hint: Save the best run with CudicSave.

prompts.text: Take a classic and make it shorter.
prompts.hint: Any classic — but the whole game has to fit in a minute.
A timer, a queue, a slow thing — a mechanic you don't usually play.

prompts.text: Build a game with no words in it.
prompts.hint: Colour, icons, motion. Explain it by letting people play.
